name: Alphabet Inc.
research_rationale: Buy-screen quality and FY2025 cash hold, but TTM FCF strain and Anthropic-linked capex headlines still modestly temper GARP; thin incremental news leaves regulatory and litigation risks unchanged.

weekly_updates.summary:
News since the October memo highlights heavy AI/datacentre spend (including Anthropic-linked headlines), post-earnings share weakness near $300, and Berkshire’s reported Q3 trim.
Yahoo data still shows TTM FCF ~$19.7bn with negative FCF in Q2–Q3 2026 as capex accelerated; SEC FY2025 FCF ~$73bn in sources is unchanged.
No new company filings in this batch; spend and return timing remain unresolved.

Thin post-memo news: Anthropic’s updated prospectus caps disclosed Google/Amazon ownership at up to 37.5%, reinforcing the AI-investment theme already in headlines.  
Screening snapshot still shows TTM FCF ~$19.7bn with negative FCF in Q2–Q3 2026; SEC FY2025 figures unchanged and no new company filings in this batch.  
No material change to the prior accumulate view.
